output.question: What is Amazon's stock split history?
output.answer: As of 2026-11-11, Amazon.com, Inc. has had four stock splits: 2-for-1 effective June 2, 1998; 3-for-1 effective January 5, 1999; 2-for-1 effective September 1, 1999; and 20-for-1 effective June 3, 2022. Amazon's own Investor Relations FAQ states that the 2022 split was announced on March 9, 2022, for shareholders of record on May 27, 2022, and that the 2022 split was the latest in the sequence. [Amazon Investor Relations](https://ir.aboutamazon.com/faqs/default.aspx)

key_facts.fact: Amazon completed a 20-for-1 common-stock split effective June 3, 2022; the record date was May 27, 2022.
Amazon completed a 2-for-1 common-stock split effective September 1, 1999; the record date was August 12, 1999.
Amazon completed a 3-for-1 common-stock split effective January 5, 1999; the record date was December 18, 1998.
Amazon completed a 2-for-1 common-stock split effective June 2, 1998; the record date was May 20, 1998.
A market-data corporate-actions record independently returns four AMZN splits, with factors 2, 3, 2 and 20 in chronological order.

passages.quote: Amazon went public on May 15, 1997, and the IPO price was $18.00, or $0.075 adjusted for the stocks splits that occurred on June 2, 1998 (2-for-1 split), January 5, 1999 (3-for-1 split), and September 1, 1999 (2-for-1 split), and June 3, 2022 (20-for-1 split).
On March 9, 2022, Amazon announced a 20-for-1 split of common shares, effective on June 3, 2022, for stockholders of record on May 27, 2022.
On July 21, 1999 Amazon announced a 2-for-1 split of common shares, effective on September 1, 1999, for stockholders of record on August 12, 1999.
On November 19, 1998, Amazon announced a 3-for-1 split of common shares, effective on January 5, 1999, for stockholders of record on December 18, 1998.
On April 27, 1998, Amazon announced a 2-for-1 split of common shares, effective on June 2, 1998, for stockholders of record on May 20, 1998.

caveats: The official Amazon FAQ gives effective dates. The marketstack corporate-actions record uses market/trading dates and reports September 2, 1999 and June 6, 2022 for the latter two events, so those dates should not be conflated with Amazon's stated effective dates.
Amazon's FAQ page does not display a publication date; it was accessed on 2026-11-11.
